experiment.name: oracle-2315-source-controls
experiment.description: Behavioral controls for the test-only propagation oracle and integration stack. Run the existing small integer/real SMT-LIB and MPS fixtures on baseline, reproducer, corrected oracle and integrated sources. These unchanged production builds must agree with the catalog's known verdicts and optima. The actual faulty-oracle rejection and lifecycle regressions run in GitHub CI; this lab job cannot exercise commonTest code. No timing or performance claim is made.
